name: onarrival
description: Search, compare and book flights and hotels on your OnArrival account. Your agent holds the fare or room and gives you a payment link you pay on OnArrival's secure payment page. It can also find the cheapest day to fly, search multi-city trips, put flights and a hotel together as one trip, compare a flight's fares, add seats, meals and bags, cancel a paid flight booking once you've seen the refund and said yes, set fare-drop alerts on WhatsApp, and search corporate fares for work trips within India.

interface.shortDescription: Book flights and hotels, pay by link
interface.longDescription: Search and compare flights and hotels, hold one on your OnArrival account, and get a payment link to pay on OnArrival's secure payment page. Find the cheapest day to fly, search multi-city trips, put flights and a hotel together as one trip, compare a flight's fares, add seats, meals and bags, cancel a paid flight booking once you've seen the refund and said yes, set a fare-drop alert on WhatsApp, and search corporate fares for work trips within India.
